_about: WhatsApp message templates in the Cloud API format (POST /{WABA_ID}/message_templates). One object per template name + language. Explained in whatsapp-templates.md. 'account' says which WhatsApp Business Account submits it: 'askhemant' = Hemant's own number (workflows 01, 05, 06); 'demo' = the DEMO test number (workflows 02, 03, 04), reusable later on a client's own account. 'used_by' lists the workflows that send it; [] = prepared for client builds, not sent by workflows 01-06. Every name in 'used_by' must exist, and the number of {{n}} variables must equal what the workflow sends: tools/test-code-nodes.mjs checks both.
